summary: Broad crypto sentiment is constructive, with altcoins continuing to attract the most aggressive bullish calls while Bitcoin is still seen as consolidating rather than leading. Macro tone is mixed-to-risk-on: equities are supported by earnings and softer oil, while Reuters coverage points to policy and geopolitical noise keeping volatility elevated.

signals.name: Bitcoin

signals.chart_pattern: flush incoming, swing-low hold, event-driven breakout/breakdown
